label: nitrogen respiration
definition: An anaerobic respiration in which a microorganism conserves energy by transferring electrons to an oxidised nitrogen compound as the terminal electron acceptor.

label: nitrate respiration
definition: A nitrogen respiration in which nitrate is the terminal electron acceptor, reduced to nitrite or further reduced products.

label: nitrite respiration
definition: A nitrogen respiration in which nitrite is the terminal electron acceptor.

label: respiration of sulfur compounds
definition: An anaerobic respiration in which a microorganism conserves energy by transferring electrons to an inorganic sulfur compound as the terminal electron acceptor.

label: sulfur respiration
definition: A respiration of sulfur compounds in which elemental sulfur is the terminal electron acceptor, reduced to sulfide.

label: thiosulfate respiration
definition: A respiration of sulfur compounds in which thiosulfate is the terminal electron acceptor.

label: hydrogenotrophic methanogenesis
definition: A methanogenesis in which carbon dioxide is reduced to methane using molecular hydrogen as the electron donor.

label: hydrocarbon degradation
definition: A metabolism in which a microorganism catabolises a hydrocarbon, using it as a carbon and energy source.

label: aromatic hydrocarbon degradation
definition: A hydrocarbon degradation in which the substrate carries at least one aromatic ring.

label: aromatic compound degradation
definition: A metabolism in which a microorganism catabolises an aromatic compound, whether or not that compound is a hydrocarbon.

label: xylanolysis
definition: A metabolism in which a microorganism hydrolyses xylan, the principal hemicellulose of plant cell walls, to xylose and xylo-oligosaccharides.

label: dark hydrogen oxidation
definition: A metabolism in which a microorganism oxidises molecular hydrogen as an electron donor for energy conservation, independently of light.

label: dark oxidation of sulfur compounds
definition: A metabolism in which a microorganism oxidises a reduced inorganic sulfur compound as an electron donor for energy conservation, independently of light.

label: methanol oxidation
definition: A metabolism in which a microorganism oxidises methanol, typically to formaldehyde, as a carbon and energy source.

label: nitrate reduction
definition: A metabolism in which a microorganism reduces nitrate, whether for energy conservation or for assimilation into biomass.
